title: Escape-route and review-submit links render live while their routes are unregistered — every click lands on the unknown-link 404 with false copy
evidence: form_pages.gleam:147-148: attribute.href("/reference/" <> token <> "/wrong-person"), attribute("data-testid", "reference-wrong-person-link"), | form_pages.gleam:157-158: attribute.href("/reference/" <> token <> "/decline"), attribute("data-testid", "reference-decline-link"), | form_pages.gleam:238-240: attribute.method("POST"), attribute.action("/reference/" <> token), attribute("data-testid", "reference-review-form"), | form_question_pages.gleam:146-150: attribute.href(qv.wrong_person_url), attribute.class("ref-escape-link"), attribute("data-testid", "reference-wrong-person-link"), | router.gleam:966-975: http.Get, ["reference", token] -> form_handler.handle_get(...) ... http.Post, ["reference", token, "resend"] -> form_handler.handle_resend(...) http.Get, ["reference", ..] -> form_handler.handle_unknown_path(req) (no wrong-person/decline/POST :token arms) | form_copy.gleam:137: pub const not_found_body = "If you were expecting a reference form, the link may have been replaced by a newer one. Check the most recent message from us, or contact us."
detail: Spec forward-links these routes to rc3-4, yet the links ship live: escape clicks land on the unknown-link page whose copy claims the link "may have been replaced"; the completed form's submit POST hits the bare wisp 404. A dead end with false copy for real referees.
recommended_fix: Register minimal truthful placeholder arms (GET wrong-person/decline, POST /reference/:token) rendering honest state pages until rc3-4 lands, or suppress the links — never serve the unknown-link copy for a link the app itself presented.
